description: Literal byte vectors for the Solana user-decrypt extraData blob — the hand-mirrored codec in kms-connector/crates/utils/src/types/solana_extra_data.rs (encode_solana_extra_data_context_only / encode_solana_extra_data_mmr_proof / parse_solana_mmr_proof_extra_data, Rust) and sdk/js-sdk/src/core/coprocessor/SolanaUserDecrypt-p.ts (buildSolanaUserDecryptContextExtraData / buildSolanaUserDecryptMmrProofExtraData, TypeScript). Encoders on both sides must produce blob_hex from input; the strict Rust parser must round-trip every record and reject every malformed entry. All hex is lowercase and unprefixed; proof_slot is a decimal string. Hand-committed literals, deliberately few — the layouts are versioned (v0x01 context-only, v0x03 MMR-proof tail) and change only with a new version byte.

records.name: context-only-v1
records.description: v0x01: version byte then the 32-byte context id, nothing else.

records.name: mmr-proof-v3
records.description: v0x03: version, context id, acl_value_key, proof_slot 42 (8 bytes BE), 3-byte length prefix (4 bytes BE), proof bytes verbatim.

records.name: current-acl-empty-proof-v3
records.description: v0x03 with slot 0 and an empty proof: a current-ACL decrypt that names an encrypted value account still uses the proof-tail version so the acl_value_key survives the wire.

malformed.name: trailing-byte
malformed.mutation: one extra 0x00 byte appended after the proof — the length prefix no longer covers the body exactly

malformed.name: truncated-proof
malformed.mutation: last proof byte removed — the body is one byte shorter than the length prefix claims

malformed.name: context-only-to-strict-parser
malformed.mutation: none — a well-formed v0x01 blob fed to the strict v0x03 parser must be rejected, not defaulted
